name: Indonesia

seo.title: Indonesia Travel Guide: Bali, Yogyakarta, Jakarta & Komodo
seo.description: Plan Indonesia travel with guides to Jakarta, Yogyakarta, Bali and Labuan Bajo: temples, culture, beaches, Komodo dragons, tips and itineraries.
seo.h1: Indonesia Travel Guide: Four Essential Destinations

heading: Indonesia Travel Guide: Four Essential Destinations
description: Indonesia is an island nation with Hindu, Buddhist, Islamic, colonial and indigenous heritage. Its main visitor circuit combines the capital Jakarta, the cultural city of Yogyakarta, the island of Bali and Labuan Bajo, the gateway to Komodo National Park.
Bali is an island destination rather than a single city, and Labuan Bajo is a small port town used as a base for national park trips. Both are best presented as destination pages in a travel website.
Indonesia has a tropical climate, and the dry season (roughly May to September) is generally the most popular time for travel.

quickFacts.Capital: Jakarta (a new capital, Nusantara, is under development; Jakarta remains the main commercial centre)
quickFacts.Languages: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia); Javanese, Balinese and many local languages
quickFacts.Entry: Visa or visa-on-arrival rules depend on nationality; check official Indonesian immigration sources

citiesSection.heading: Top Cities in Indonesia
citiesSection.body: Choose a city to see its main places to visit.

cities.name: Jakarta
cities.intro: Jakarta is Indonesia’s largest city and a major political, economic, cultural and commercial centre.
cities.knownFor: Capital city, colonial heritage, museums, food, Thousand Islands

cities.name: Yogyakarta
cities.intro: Yogyakarta is one of Indonesia’s most important centres of Javanese culture, education, traditional arts, batik, dance and royal heritage.
cities.knownFor: Borobudur, Prambanan, Javanese royal culture, batik

cities.name: Bali
cities.intro: Bali is internationally known for Hindu culture, beaches, rice terraces, temples, dance, crafts, wellness tourism and hospitality.
cities.knownFor: Hindu temples, rice terraces, beaches, arts, wellness

cities.name: Labuan Bajo and Komodo
cities.intro: Labuan Bajo is a small port town on the western tip of Flores and the main gateway to Komodo National Park.
cities.knownFor: Komodo dragons, island cruises, diving, snorkelling
cities.bestTime: April–December (dry season); conditions vary by activity
